text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, June 8, 2018 Posted by admin on June 8th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL), Boeing (BA), Microsoft (MSFT), Nike (NKE) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -72 points.
Thursday the Dow was up +346.41 (+1.40%) at 25,146.39.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +1.73%.
There were 21 Dow stocks up Thursday .
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by McDonald’s (MCD) +4.37% and Chevron (CVX) +2.90%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Intel (INTC) -2.02% and Visa (V) -1.79%.
Apple (AAPL -0.27%) is down 2% in premarket trading after the Nikkei reported that Apple told its supply chain to prepare for -20% fewer components for iPhones debuting in the second half of this year compared with last year’s orders.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down six-tenths of a cent at $2.934 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to report earnings in the near term.
